verses.pali: “Pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato āvāsiko bhikkhu yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ niraye.
verses.english: “Mendicants, a resident mendicant with five qualities is placed in hell as if delivered there.
Without examining or scrutinizing, they praise those deserving of criticism,
and they criticize those deserving of praise.

verses.pali: ananuvicca apariyogāhetvā appasādanīye ṭhāne pasādaṁ upadaṁseti;
verses.english: Without examining or scrutinizing, they arouse faith in things that are dubious,

verses.pali: ananuvicca apariyogāhetvā pasādanīye ṭhāne appasādaṁ upadaṁseti;
verses.english: and they don’t arouse faith in things that are inspiring.
And they waste a gift given in faith.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato āvāsiko bhikkhu yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ niraye.
verses.english: A resident mendicant with these five qualities is placed in hell as if delivered there.

verses.pali: Pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato āvāsiko bhikkhu yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ sagge.
verses.english: A resident mendicant with five qualities is placed in heaven as if delivered there.
After examining and scrutinizing, they criticize those deserving of criticism,
and they praise those deserving of praise.

verses.pali: anuvicca pariyogāhetvā appasādanīye ṭhāne appasādaṁ upadaṁseti;
verses.english: They don’t arouse faith in things that are dubious,

verses.pali: anuvicca pariyogāhetvā pasādanīye ṭhāne pasādaṁ upadaṁseti;
verses.english: and they do arouse faith in things that are inspiring.
And they don’t waste a gift given in faith.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato āvāsiko bhikkhu yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ sagge”ti.
verses.english: A resident mendicant with these five qualities is placed in heaven as if delivered there.”
